consequence.statement: This only changes the pinned version of the GitHub Actions codeql-action used in the upstream repository's workflows; no deployed external-secrets component (chart, controller, webhook, cert-controller) is affected and no operator action is required.

assertion.statement: external-secrets 0.16.0 bumps its github/codeql-action dependency from 3.28.13 to 3.28.15 (PR #4645, via dependabot).

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: github/codeql-action is a CI workflow dependency of the upstream repository; no Helm value, CLI flag, manifest, image or other environment input references it, so no exposure condition can be expressed from an environment's configuration.
